(3) The camera returns to the woman in the office as she continues her explanation, holding up a small yellow and white box of medication labeled 'Roaccutane'. (4) A cinematic b-roll shot shows a man sleeping peacefully in a dimly lit bedroom under blue sheets, simulating a night environment. (5) The woman reappears, gesturing with her fingers to list points while variety-style text overlays appear around her head. (6) The video concludes with a static graphic displaying the clinic's logo, phone number, and addresses in Taiwan.
